title: Thai Coconut Chicken Soup
teaser: A fragrant coconut broth with tender chicken, ready in under half an hour.
steps: Bring the stock to a simmer in a large pot with the ginger and curry paste.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook for 8-10 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in the fish sauce and lime juice.
Ladle into bowls and top with coriander.

title: Spicy Sausage & Butter Bean Soup
teaser: A warming, one-pot soup that turns a pack of sausages and a tin of beans into a full meal.
steps: Squeeze the sausage meat out of the skins into small chunks. Heat a little oil in a large pot and fry the sausage pieces until browned.
Add the onion and garlic and cook for 4-5 minutes until softened.
Stir in the smoked paprika and chilli flakes and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the chopped tomatoes, butter beans, and stock.
Simmer for 15-18 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened. Season to taste and serve with bread.

title: Minestrone Soup
teaser: A classic vegetable and bean soup that uses up odds and ends from the fridge, with small pasta to bulk it out.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and fry the onion, carrots, and celery for 5-6 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the chopped tomatoes, cannellini beans, and vegetable stock, and bring to a simmer.
Add the pasta and cook for 10-12 minutes until tender.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

title: Creamy Tomato & White Bean Soup
teaser: A cosy, creamy tomato soup with white beans for extra heartiness.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a pot and cook the onion and garlic for 4-5 minutes until soft.
Add the chopped tomatoes, white beans, and stock, then bring to a simmer.
Cook for 15 minutes, then blend until smooth, or leave chunky if you prefer.
Stir in the double cream and season with salt and pepper.
Serve warm with crusty bread.

title: Fried Egg & Avocado Toast
teaser: Breakfast food is fair game for dinner, and this one takes ten minutes.
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with a little salt, pepper, and olive oil, and spread onto the toast.
Fry the eggs to your liking in a little oil.
Top the toast with the eggs and a pinch of chilli flakes if you like.

title: Cheesy Baked Beans on Toast
teaser: About as low-effort as dinner can get, and genuinely satisfying.
steps: Warm the baked beans in a small pan over medium heat.
Toast and butter the bread.
Pile the beans onto the toast.
Top with grated cheddar and grill for 1-2 minutes if you'd like it melted, or serve as is.

title: Veggie Omelette
teaser: A flexible way to use up whatever vegetables are left in the fridge.

ingredients.item: Handful spinach or mixed vegetables, chopped small

steps: Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a frying pan over medium heat and add the vegetables, cooking for 2-3 minutes until softened.
Pour in the eggs and let them set around the edges, then gently push the cooked edges towards the centre.
Sprinkle the cheese over one half, fold the omelette over, and slide onto a plate.

title: Halloumi Wrap with Sweet Chilli
teaser: Fried halloumi, salad, and sweet chilli sauce rolled into a wrap.
steps: Fry the halloumi slices in a little oil until golden on both sides, about 2 minutes per side.
Warm the tortillas briefly if you like.
Layer the lettuce and halloumi onto the wraps.
Drizzle with sweet chilli sauce, roll up, and serve.

title: Chicken Caesar Wrap
teaser: A lunch-counter classic that works just as well for dinner.

ingredients.item: chicken breast, sliced (or leftover roast chicken)
Handful romaine or cos lettuce, shredded

steps: Toss the lettuce with the caesar dressing and parmesan.
Lay the chicken over each wrap.
Top with the dressed lettuce.
Roll up tightly and slice in half to serve.

title: Falafel Wrap with Hummus
teaser: Shop-bought falafel and hummus make this a five-minute assembly job.
steps: Warm the falafel according to packet instructions.
Spread hummus over the wraps.
Layer in the lettuce, cucumber, tomato, and falafel.
Roll up and serve, or wrap in foil to eat on the go.

title: BLT Sandwich
teaser: Bacon, lettuce, and tomato — a sandwich that never needs improving.
steps: Fry or grill the bacon until crisp.
Toast the bread if you like.
Spread mayonnaise on the bread.
Layer the bacon, lettuce, and tomato, then close the sandwich and slice in half.

title: Chicken Shawarma Wrap
teaser: Spiced chicken strips with a garlic yoghurt sauce, rolled into a warm wrap.

ingredients.item: shawarma or mixed spice (cumin, paprika, turmeric)

steps: Toss the chicken with the spices and a little oil.
Fry in a hot pan for 6-8 minutes until cooked through and lightly charred.
Mix the yoghurt with the garlic to make a quick sauce.
Warm the tortillas and layer with lettuce, tomato, and chicken.
Drizzle with the yoghurt sauce, roll up, and serve.

title: BBQ Chicken Wraps
teaser: Shredded or sliced chicken tossed in barbecue sauce and rolled into a wrap.

ingredients.item: chicken breast, shredded (or leftover roast chicken)

steps: Toss the shredded chicken with the barbecue sauce.
Warm the tortillas briefly if you like.
Layer the lettuce, chicken, and cheese onto the wraps.
Roll up tightly and slice in half to serve.

title: Sloppy Joe Rolls
teaser: A messy, saucy mince filling piled into soft bread rolls.
steps: Fry the onion in a little oil for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the mince and brown, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the tomatoes, Worcestershire sauce, brown sugar, and mustard.
Simmer for 12-15 minutes until thickened.
Split the rolls and pile the mince mixture inside.

title: Greek Chicken Pitta Wrap
teaser: Grilled chicken, tzatziki, and salad rolled into a warm pitta.

ingredients.item: tzatziki (or yoghurt mixed with grated cucumber and garlic)
Few slices tomato and red onion

steps: Toss the chicken with the oregano and a little oil.
Fry in a hot pan for 6-8 minutes until cooked through and lightly charred.
Warm the pittas.
Layer the lettuce, tomato, onion, and chicken into the pittas.
Drizzle with tzatziki, roll or fold, and serve.
